cardiorespiratory.name: Cardiorespiratory
cardiorespiratory.evidence: Strongest single predictor of all-cause mortality among fitness components (ACSM, 2022).

muscular_strength.name: Strength
muscular_strength.evidence: Inversely associated with all-cause mortality independent of cardiorespiratory fitness (ACSM, 2022).

muscular_endurance.name: Endurance
muscular_endurance.evidence: Predicts functional capacity and daily-task tolerance more reliably than max strength alone (ACSM, 2022).

flexibility.name: Flexibility
flexibility.evidence: Joint-specific; correlates with movement quality and injury risk reduction (ACSM, 2022).

body_composition.name: Body composition
body_composition.evidence: Independent risk modifier for cardiometabolic disease across all BMI ranges (NHANES 2017–2020).

power.name: Power
power.evidence: Declines earlier than strength with age; key marker of fall risk in older adults (NSCA Essentials, 4e).

balance.name: Balance
balance.evidence: Strongest single test-based predictor of fall risk in adults over 65 (Berg Balance Scale literature).

coordination.name: Coordination
coordination.evidence: Underpins skill transfer; trainable independently of strength or endurance (NSCA Essentials, 4e).

agility.name: Agility
agility.evidence: Combined cognitive-motor demand; deficits track with elevated injury rates in cutting sports (NSCA Essentials, 4e).

cognitive_motor.name: Cognitive-motor
cognitive_motor.evidence: Dual-task performance independently predicts long-term functional independence (Plummer et al., 2013).

movement_quality.name: Movement quality
movement_quality.evidence: Pattern integrity gates safe loading regardless of measured strength (FMS / SFMA literature).

autonomic_regulation.name: Autonomic regulation
autonomic_regulation.evidence: Resting cardiovascular and respiratory baselines independently predict cardiometabolic risk and recovery capacity (ESC, Framingham).

billing.premium_pack_desc: Standalone top-up. Use it when you need our most capable model (Claude Sonnet) for red-flag cases or complex periodisation. Cost covers the model + ~30% margin. Valid until the end of the next cycle.
billing.verify_subscription_title: Sync your subscription state with Stripe
billing.footer_secure: Secure payments via Stripe. Cancel anytime in the portal.
billing.tier_starter_tagline: For PTs with up to 8 active clients
billing.faq_a1: One generation = a new 4-week mesocycle (Brief + Blueprint + Microcycle + Progressions) for one client. Manual edits, re-running just the progressions, or re-printing the PDF do NOT count as a new generation.
billing.faq_a2: Active = any client with at least one logged session in the past 60 days OR a plan generated in the past 60 days. Inactive clients stay stored but don't count toward the cap — when they train again, they count again.
billing.faq_q3: What if I exceed monthly generations?
billing.faq_a3: We warn you at 80%. You can buy a top-up pack (10 generations for €12) or wait for day 1 of the next cycle. We never charge without confirmation.
billing.faq_a4: Premium escalation = we run your plan with our most capable model (Claude Sonnet) for red-flag cases or complex periodisation. €1.50 covers the model cost + ~30% margin for infra and support.
billing.faq_q5: What happens to my client data?
billing.faq_a5: Stored in the EU with encryption. You can export everything as JSON or delete any client at any time, in Settings. If you cancel, we keep data for 90 days so you can reactivate; after that it's deleted.

injuries.medical_doc_question: Do you have medical documentation relevant to exercise?
injuries.notes_placeholder: e.g. pain when raising arm above head

note.rotator_cuff: Common with repetitive overhead motion. Avoid painful vertical press; modify range.
note.shoulder_impingement: Pain on lateral arm raise. Reduce overhead volume; work thoracic mobility.
note.frozen_shoulder: Global mobility loss. Passive and pendulum work before loading.
note.tennis_elbow: Lateral epicondyle pain. Reduce resisted wrist extension; eccentric protocol.
note.golfer_elbow: Medial epicondyle pain. Reduce resisted wrist flexion; eccentric protocol.
note.carpal_tunnel: Finger numbness/tingling. Avoid sustained wrist flexion; nerve mobility.
note.lumbar_disc: Avoid loaded lumbar flexion. Train neutral hip hinge and anti-extension core.
note.sciatica: Leg-radiating pain. Identify direction that relieves (extension vs flexion) and prioritise.
note.scoliosis: Asymmetric curvature. Asymmetric unilateral work and thoracic mobility.
note.hip_impingement: Pain in deep hip flexion. Reduce squat depth; work mobility.
note.hip_bursitis: Lateral hip pain. Avoid excessive adduction; strengthen abductors.
note.patellar_tendinopathy: Pain below the kneecap. Progressive eccentrics; reduce jumps.
note.meniscus_tear: Pain with loaded rotation. Avoid pivots; work pain-free strength.
note.acl_tear: Post-op requires guided protocol. Avoid pivots and abrupt decelerations.
note.it_band: Lateral knee pain. Strengthen gluteus medius; reduce running volume.
note.ankle_sprain: Recurrent history needs proprioceptive and ankle strength work.
note.achilles_tendinopathy: Tendon pain. Slow eccentrics; reduce jumps and intense running.
note.plantar_fasciitis: Morning plantar pain. Foot and calf mobility; supportive footwear.
note.muscle_strain: Muscle strain. Active rest and gradual load progression.
note.tendinopathy_generic: Generic tendinopathy. Slow eccentrics and load progression.
note.unknown: No diagnosis. Modify pain-provoking exercises; refer if persistent.
